description: Stay on goldmark v1. v2 is a rewrite (generic renderers, a new Node interface, extensions moved), not an upgrade a bot can apply: Renovate's PR rewrote html.go's imports but not math.go's extension and could not compile. The fleet's other Markdown code (go-richdoc/markdown) is on v1 too. Migrating is a deliberate piece of work, to be done by hand when v2 brings something we need.
